x: Reiterer and Olukoju both launched 60 metre throws in round one and with Birchfield and England's Bob Weir putting the platter over the same line in round three, no one else came near.
Kevin Brown scored well in shot and discus (where a mighty 61m throw from Birchfield's Bob Weir broke the league record) while Leith Marar took the 'B' discus by a clear margin.

The same sort of fate befell Kevin Brown, 3rd in the Discus as Birchfield's big Bob Weir went over 60m but Hammer thrower Dave Smith confirmed his number one standing this season with another throw over 72 metres.

…ride patten Linford made amends in the 100m with a new Cup record of 10.28 secs, but the Man of the Match Award went to Bob Weir of Birchfield who broke the Cup discus record with an impressive 62.40.…
It was also a last round effort that took Kevin Brown into the Discus medals where an awesome Bob Weir had the beating of the field with every one of his six throws.
